notes: ⚠ A THIRD 2016 SCHEDULE-B TEMPLATE — the 2016 blanks were stocked INDEPENDENTLY, cover from schedules (addendum F6), and this filing proves it INSIDE one cycle and one seat. The cover here is the SAME blank Voeks 17bb61d5 used — 'FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY & LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD CANDIDATES', 'Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5 & 20A-11-13', 'HEART of UTAH' mountain letterhead, inner sheets strap-lined '2016 County Commission & Local School Board Candidate' — but its SCHEDULE B COLUMN IS HEADED 'Expenditure', where Voeks's Schedule B on the same cover blank reuses Schedule A's 'Name of Contributor'.
